title: Evaluating the stack assignment
statement: For every stack word $xs$ and every index $i\in\{0,1,2,3\}$, the assignment that places $xs$ on the main stack and leaves the other stacks empty, evaluated at the stack named by $i$, equals $xs$ if $i=0$ and the empty word otherwise.
replaced:
Evaluating the assignment that stores a word $xs$ on the main stack at the stack
name enumerated by an index $i \in \{0, 1, 2, 3\}$ yields $xs$ when $i = 0$ (the
main stack) and the empty stack otherwise.
